coordinate_policy.reason: The supplied pickup/drop-off coordinates are not internally consistent with distance_km and are excluded from the current train.py feature set.
coordinate_policy.live_app_behavior: The Streamlit app detects this legacy coordinate-dependent metadata and rebuilds a coordinate-safe Linear Regression for live prediction instead of using this packaged artifact.

current_training_methodology: train.py excludes pickup/drop-off coordinates, uses 5-fold cross-validation on the training partition only, selects the lowest mean CV RMSE, and evaluates the selected model once on the untouched holdout test set.
note: This metadata describes a retained historical baseline artifact. It must not be presented as the current coordinate-safe production model. Passenger count is absent from the supplied dataset and is not fabricated.
